Ratio multiplies each raw pixel by NR / clean, so every noisy sample keeps its own hue and only its brightness and tint move. Recommended.\nDifference adds NR - clean as an absolute amount. On samples that came back dark that amount outweighs the sample, which recolours them and roughly doubles the colour noise the upscaler receives.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 推荐用比例相乘，按处理前后的比例调整每个像素，能较好保留含噪样本的色相。\n差值相加会将变化量直接叠到原始像素上，较暗的样本更容易变色，可能加重超分输入的彩色噪点。

Limits the interpolated edit to the range of the four nearest source pixels. Removes ringing from the sharper kernels at the cost of a little sharpness.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 将插值结果限制在最近四个源像素的范围内。能抑制锐利滤镜带来的边缘振铃，但锐度会略有降低。

Engines disagree on which way the jitter value points. The wrong direction doubles the misalignment instead of removing it. If edges look worse with the shift on than off, flip this.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 不同引擎的采样偏移方向可能相反。如果开启对齐后边缘反而更差，可反转方向。

How the edit is interpolated at the shifted position. Bilinear is soft and never overshoots. Catmull-Rom is sharp with little overshoot. Lanczos 2 is the sharpest and can ring around hard edges.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 设置对齐后的插值方式。双线性较柔和；Catmull-Rom 较锐利；Lanczos 2 最锐利，但硬边周围可能出现振铃。

The clean image sits on a steady pixel grid; the raw render is offset by a sub-pixel jitter that changes every frame. Shifting the edit by that jitter lines the two up. Turn off only to compare.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 降噪画面的像素位置固定，原始画面每帧有亚像素偏移。按相同偏移移动效果即可对齐，建议仅在对比时关闭。

A raw sample far brighter than the clean value is a path-tracing firefly, not a lit pixel. Multiplying it by the ratio makes it brighter, and when the camera is still the game's Ray Reconstruction can keep such sparkles in shadows. With this on, those samples get the absolute change their pixel would have had instead. Turn off to compare.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 路径追踪有时会产生远亮于周边的异常采样。开启后，对这些采样采用差值调整，避免成倍放大亮点，尤其能减少静止画面阴影中的闪点。

Below 100%: Lighting + colour resizes lighting gain and colour changes separately, then applies them at full resolution. This can reduce resize halos; fully black pixels remain black. Edge-aware uses the original picture's brightness to keep edits on the correct side of edges. DLSS modes require post-upscale DX12 processing.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 低于 100% 时，「光照与颜色」会分别缩放两类变化，再按原分辨率应用，可减少光晕并保留纯黑像素。「保留边缘」会按原图亮度限制效果范围。DLSS 模式需要在 DX12 超分后进行处理。

Game upscaler again: the game's upscaler receives the NR'd clean image. Simple, but the second pass gets no real sub-pixel samples, so it can look softer than native.

Private DLSS SR: the same, but a separate plain DLSS pass does the upscale and replaces the output. Avoids running Ray Reconstruction twice.

Edit onto the raw render: only NR's change is taken from the clean image, lined up with the raw render's jitter and added onto it. The game's upscaler then sees real samples carrying the edit. Sharpest in theory; Ray Reconstruction may soften part of the edit.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。:
再次运行游戏超分器：将已降噪并完成神经渲染的画面交给游戏超分器。第二次处理缺少真实的亚像素样本，可能偏柔和。

独立 DLSS 超分：单独运行 DLSS 来放大画面，避免重复执行光线重建。

应用到原始画面：仅将神经渲染产生的变化对齐到原始采样，再交给游戏超分器。细节可能更清晰，但光线重建也可能柔化部分效果。

Locked to disabled: AmpereMfgMode=Internal drives OptiScaler's own FG route (startup-only; change DLSSG.AmpereMfgMode).
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 已锁定为关闭。内部模式会使用 OptiScaler 自己的帧生成，修改模式后要重启游戏。

Automatically locked to enabled because the RTX 20 / 30 MFG unlocker is active.\nTo disable External FG, turn off the DLSS MFG unlocker below first.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: RTX 20 / 30 的多帧生成已启用，因此外部帧生成会保持开启。要关闭它，请先关闭下方的 DLSS 多帧生成扩展。

Leaves Streamline, Reflex and FG control to the game/external mod.\nNR and NGX upscaling remain available. Save Settings and restart.\nDoes not install an unlocker or enable FG in unsupported games.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 由游戏或外部补丁控制 Streamline、Reflex 和帧生成。神经渲染和 NGX 超分仍可使用。保存设置并重启后生效；此项本身不会为游戏新增帧生成。

Auto picks the unlocker for the GPU found at startup: RTX 40 -> RTX 40 unlock,
RTX 20 / 30 -> RTX 20 / 30 unlocker. Choose one by hand only if the GPU was not
identified. Entries for another GPU family are greyed out.
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 自动模式会根据启动时检测到的显卡选用 RTX 40 或 RTX 20 / 30 路径。仅当识别失败时才需手选，其他系列的选项会变灰。保存后重启生效。

Startup reads the PCI ids of the installed GPUs; the driver reports the GPU the game uses.\nThe log line "DLSS FG unlocker:" lists what was found.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 启动时读取显卡 PCI ID，并由驱动报告游戏实际使用的显卡。可在日志中搜索「DLSS FG unlocker:」查看检测结果。
RTX 40（Ada）

Retargets optimized Blackwell PTX interpolation kernels in nvngx_dlssg.dll to Ada (sm_89).\nRecommended for smooth 3X-6X frame pacing on high-refresh VRR/FreeSync/G-Sync monitors.\nSave Settings and restart after changing.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 适用于 Ada 显卡。在支持可变刷新率的高刷屏上，有助于改善三至六倍帧生成的帧间隔。保存后重启生效。

Highest multiplier offered to the game (1=2X, 2=3X, 3=4X, 4=5X, 5=6X).
The game's frame generation setting (or Override DLSSG Ratio) still picks the active multiplier;
this only hides the options above the ceiling.

Setting it to 1 (up to 2X only) tells the game Multi Frame Generation is unsupported, so its 3X+ options disappear.
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 设置游戏可见的最高倍率：1 至 5 分别对应 2X 至 6X。实际倍率仍由游戏或 DLSSG 倍率设置决定。设为 1 会隐藏三倍及以上选项。保存后重启生效。

DLSS Frame Generation preset for this game only (the saved NVIDIA profile is not changed).
Auto: the game / NVIDIA app decides.
A, B: NVIDIA's original frame generation models.
C: NVIDIA's performance mode, lighter on the GPU (DLSS-G 310.9.16 and newer).
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 仅对本游戏生效。自动由游戏或 NVIDIA App 决定；A、B 为原始模型；C 为性能模式，需要 DLSS-G 310.9.16 或更高版本。保存后重启生效。
RTX 20 / 30（Turing / Ampere）

On Linux/Proton, native dlssg_sm86 driver hooks are replaced by OptiScaler's\ninternal FG pipeline (DLSSG -> FSR FG / XeFG) for crash-free, flicker-free presentation.\nUse the settings below to adjust fallback behavior or pipeline target.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: Linux / Proton 可使用 OptiScaler 内部帧生成，将 DLSS-G 输入交给 FSR FG 或 XeFG。在下方设置何时使用备用路径和输出方式。

The game's own XeSS-FG library can run on GeForce cards (for example after a DLSS Swapper upgrade) and would take the swapchain, leaving DLSS-G without frames.\nOptiScaler answers its context request with 'unsupported device', as the Intel-only builds do on GeForce.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 游戏自带的跨品牌 XeSS-FG 可能先接管交换链，使 DLSS-G 无法获得画面。此项让 DLSS-G 保持控制。

External mode only. Stops the game's own XeSS Frame Generation from taking the swapchain from DLSS-G (it happens with a cross-vendor libxess_fg.dll, e.g. after a DLSS Swapper upgrade). Turn off only if you want the game's XeSS FG instead of DLSS-G.\nSave Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 仅适用于外部模式。要改用游戏自己的 XeSS 帧生成，可关闭此项。保存后重启生效。

External: forces External FG mode; the game or unlocker controls MFG (historic default).\nInternal: keeps OptiScaler's own FG route active and serves DLSS-G through the sideloaded dlssg_sm86 runtime on SM86/SM75. Requires FGOutput=dlssg; the FG Nvngx replacement stays None. Experimental and startup-only.\nSave Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 外部模式由游戏或补丁控制多帧生成，为原有默认值。内部模式由 OptiScaler 调用 SM75 / SM86 对应运行库，需要 FGOutput=dlssg，帧生成的 Nvngx 替换保持 None。内部模式为实验功能，保存后重启生效。

Locked to Dynamic (Up to 6X) while Dynamic Multi-Frame Generation is enabled.\nThe NVIDIA runtime dynamically scales generated frames to meet the FPS Target.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 启用动态多帧生成时，此项锁定为动态模式，最高 6X。运行库会根据目标帧率调整插入帧数。

Maximum multiplier capability advertised to the game engine (1=2X, 2=3X, 3=4X, 4=5X, 5=6X).
The game's graphics settings menu chooses the actual active multiplier.

Important: Setting this to 1 (up to 2X only) tells the game engine that Multi-Frame Generation (3X/4X) is not supported. Games with in-engine multiplier selectors (e.g. Where Winds Meet, Black Myth: Wukong, Final Fantasy) will hide their 2x/3x selection dropdowns and lock to standard 2X.
Keep this at Factory default (4X) or higher so in-game menus remain accessible.

Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 游戏可见的最高倍率：1 至 5 对应 2X 至 6X。选择 1 时，有些游戏会隐藏倍率菜单并固定为 2X。要保留游戏内的倍率选择，可使用默认 4X 或更高。保存后重启生效。

Optimization consistency tier for generated frames:
0 - Stock: Original stock numerics, no kernel acceleration (conservative).
1 - Bit-identical: Recommended default. Fastest kernel pipeline with 0 dB deviation (~19-32% GPU latency reduction).
2 - Fast lossy: Faster image-processing kernels with PSNR > 50 dB against stock output (310.9 runtime only).
3 - Fastest lossy: All lossy accelerations enabled, including texture-unit bilinear sampling.
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 0：原版计算。1：结果与原版一致，为推荐默认值。2：更快的有损计算，仅适用于 310.9 运行库。3：最快的有损模式，包含纹理单元双线性采样。保存后重启生效。

Preset for UI / HUD recomposition / FG Lite:
Auto: Let the game or driver profile decide (default). sdli1995 0.4.1 and newer run Auto as A.
A: Force UI recomposition off.
B: Force UI recomposition on for cleaner HUD inside generated frames (only takes effect if game provides HUD-less plane).
C: FG Lite: 30-50% faster kernel execution with lighter candidate blending.
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 自动由游戏或驱动决定，sdli1995 0.4.1 起按 A 处理。A 关闭界面重组；B 在游戏提供不含界面的画面时改善插入帧里的界面；C 使用负载较低的 FG Lite。保存后重启生效。

Auto: resolves to optimal format (PTX on Linux/Proton, RTX 3080 Ti, or Turing).
PTX: JIT-compiled driver path, recommended for Linux/Proton, RTX 3080 Ti, and RTX 20 series.
Cubin: precompiled binary, requires exact physical SM match on Windows.
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 自动根据环境选择。PTX 由驱动即时编译，适合 Linux / Proton、RTX 3080 Ti 和 RTX 20；Cubin 为预编译内核，在 Windows 上需匹配实际 SM 架构。保存后重启生效。

Auto: automatically selects SM75 for Turing or SM86 for Ampere.
SM86: Ampere route (RTX 30 series).
SM75: Turing route (RTX 20 / GTX 16 series, or SM75 forward-PTX testing on RTX 3080 Ti).
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 自动为 Turing 选择 SM75，为 Ampere 选择 SM86。SM86 适用 RTX 30；SM75 适用 RTX 20、GTX 16，也可用于 RTX 3080 Ti 的 PTX 测试。保存后重启生效。

Disabled: requires SilyNoMeta's fork of dlssg_sm86 (or a build supporting DynamicMFG).\nUpstream sdli1995 does not support dynamic mode yet.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 需要支持 DynamicMFG 的 dlssg_sm86 版本。原版 sdli1995 目前不支持，因此这里不可选。

Requests dynamic multi-frame generation pacing in SilyNoMeta's dlssg_sm86.\nDynamically adjusts generated frames to match display refresh rate or target FPS.\nApplies live to running mod engine and updates companion configuration.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 自动调整每帧插入的帧数，以接近显示器刷新率或设定的目标帧率。修改会立即生效并同步到配套配置。

An active limit of 0 means auto-detect the display refresh rate.\nNon-zero values (e.g. 120) set a fixed dynamic framerate ceiling.\nApplies live to running mod engine and updates companion configuration.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 0 表示自动检测显示器刷新率；其他值为固定目标帧率，例如 120。修改会立即生效并同步到配套配置。

Controls architecture reporting to the game and Streamline 2.8+ at startup:
Auto: Installs an early NVAPI trampoline so Turing (RTX 20) and Ampere (RTX 30) report
      Blackwell (RTX 50, 0x1b0), preventing games like FF7 Rebirth from dropping the DLSS-G plugin.
Enabled: Explicitly forces early Blackwell architecture spoofing across all GPUs.
Disabled: Keeps the real GPU architecture (SpoofArchToGame=0).
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 选择报告给游戏和 Streamline 的显卡架构。自动按显卡选择，启用会报告 Blackwell，关闭则保留真实架构。保存后重启生效。

Controls dlssg_sm86 logging level written to dlssg_sm86.ini [Logging] Level:
0: Off (minimal logging)
1: Default (info and error logging)
2: Debug
3: Trace / Verbose (detailed per-frame kernel execution and evaluate logs for troubleshooting)
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 日志写入 dlssg_sm86.ini 的 Logging / Level。0 最少，1 记录常规信息和错误，2 为调试，3 逐帧记录详细信息。保存后重启生效。

Control fallback to OptiScaler's internal FG pipeline on Linux/Proton:
Auto: Falls back to internal FG only when configured for 2X FG (MaxFrames=1).
Force Enabled: Always uses internal FG, bypassing native dlssg_sm86 for smooth pacing.
Force Disabled: Always uses external dlssg_sm86 mod.
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: Linux / Proton 备用方式：自动仅在 2X 时启用；强制开启始终使用内部帧生成；强制关闭始终使用外部 dlssg_sm86。保存后重启生效。

Select internal FG pipeline used during Linux fallback:
XeFG: Intel XeSS FG (default). Its files ship with OptiScaler.
FSR FG: AMD FSR FG. Use it for games with 16-bit float HDR output, which XeFG does not support.
Save Settings and restart to apply.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: Linux 备用输出默认使用 Intel XeFG。游戏使用 16 位浮点 HDR 输出时，可选支持该格式的 AMD FSR FG。保存后重启生效。

Disabled because the game is running under the Vulkan API.\nIntel XeSS Frame Generation (XeFG) strictly requires DirectX 12.\nIf the game supports DirectX 12, switch the Graphics API to DirectX 12 in the game settings and restart.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 当前使用 Vulkan。Intel XeFG 需要 DirectX 12；如果游戏支持，请在画面设置中切换至 DirectX 12 并重启。

Disabled because the RTX 40 MFG unlock is active.\nTurn off the DLSS MFG unlocker first, Save Settings and restart.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: RTX 40 的 DLSS 多帧生成已开启。要使用此项，请先关闭 DLSS 多帧生成，保存并重启。

Natively unlocks Intel Xe Multi-Frame Generation (XeMFG) in libxess_fg.dll.
Allows 3X, 4X, 5X, and 6X frame generation across Intel, AMD, and NVIDIA GPUs.
Supports both native DLSS-G / Streamline titles and OptiScaler pipeline injection.
Provides native Multi-Frame Generation on Linux (Proton/VKD3D) without 2X fallbacks.
Save Settings and restart after changing.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 启用 Intel Xe 多帧生成，可提供 3X 至 6X。可使用游戏原生 DLSS-G / Streamline 输入，也可用 OptiScaler 提供的输入。支持的显卡和效果取决于驱动及游戏。保存后重启生效。

Determines how frame generation inputs (depth, motion vectors, HUD) are fed into XeFG:
• Game: For titles with native DLSS Frame Generation / Streamline support. Unlocks in-game settings.
• OptiScaler: For games with DLSS Super Resolution lacking native DLSS-FG (e.g. Helldivers 2).
  Injects XeFG directly using vectors and depth from the upscaler pass.
Save Settings and restart after changing.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 「游戏」适用于原生支持 DLSS 帧生成或 Streamline 的游戏。「OptiScaler」适用于有 DLSS 超分、缺少原生帧生成的游戏，使用超分阶段的深度和运动矢量。保存后重启生效。

Real-time presentation status from xefgSwapChainGetLastPresentStatus.\nIndicates whether Intel XeSS-FG is actively producing neural interpolated frames\nor silently falling back to native frames.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 显示 Intel XeFG 最近一次提交画面的状态，可判断是否实际生成了插入帧，或已回退到游戏原始帧。

Multiplier selected by the game engine, Streamline options call, or OptiScaler injection.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 由游戏、Streamline 或 OptiScaler 选择的实际倍率。

Frame generation is currently set to Off in the game's display settings.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 游戏画面设置中的帧生成当前已关闭。

In-game multiplier will be reported once the game's Streamline DLSS-G option is set.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 游戏设置好 Streamline DLSS-G 选项后，将显示实际倍率。

Number of interpolated frames generated per real rendered frame (allowed in XeFG and advertised to Streamline).
1 = 2X FG (1 interpolated frame)
2 = 3X FG (2 interpolated frames)
3 = 4X FG (3 interpolated frames, default)
4 = 5X FG (4 interpolated frames)
5 = 6X FG (5 interpolated frames)
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 每个真实渲染帧可插入的帧数。1 至 5 分别对应 2X 至 6X，默认 3 表示 4X。

Renders marker quads in the corners of real interpolated frames.\nIf you do not see marker quads, frames are not being interpolated.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 在实际生成的插入帧四角显示标记，便于检查插帧是否生效。

Renders ONLY generated frames and blanks native frames.\nIf interpolation is active, motion will remain visible.\nIf interpolation has failed, the screen will turn black.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 仅显示生成帧，原始帧显示为黑色。插帧正常时仍能看到运动画面，失败时画面为黑色。

Forces SyncInterval=1 and disables tearing on generated frames.\nRecommended: OFF (Default) — allows XeSS-FG to pace presentations natively.\nEnable only if your display exhibits severe tear-lines without V-Sync.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 开启后强制同步并禁止撕裂。默认关闭，由 XeFG 自行控制帧间隔。仅在未启用垂直同步且画面严重撕裂时考虑开启。

Forces borderless windowed mode on swapchains.\nRequired for games that use DXGI exclusive fullscreen (e.g. Helldivers 2),\nas Intel XeFG disables frame interpolation in exclusive fullscreen.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 强制使用无边框窗口。XeFG 在独占全屏下会停止插帧，部分游戏需要开启此项。

Disabled because Frame Generation (DLSS-G / MFG) is active.\nNVIDIA Smooth Motion is driver-level frame generation for games lacking native DLSS-G.\nDisable MFG / Frame Generation first, Save Settings and restart to use Smooth Motion.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: DLSS 帧生成或多帧生成正在运行。驱动级平滑动态适用于缺少原生 DLSS-G 的游戏。要切换，请先关闭帧生成，保存后重启。

Disabled because the active OS is not Windows (10/11).\nNVIDIA Smooth Motion is a Windows-only driver display pipeline feature (requires driver 571.86+ on Windows).
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 平滑动态需要 Windows 10 / 11 和 571.86 或更高版本驱动。当前系统不支持。

Disabled because the active GPU is not NVIDIA.\nNVIDIA Smooth Motion requires an NVIDIA GPU and driver 571.86+ on Windows.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 平滑动态需要 NVIDIA 显卡和 Windows 版 571.86 或更高版本驱动。当前使用的是其他品牌显卡。

Disabled because the active GPU is not NVIDIA Ampere (RTX 30), Ada Lovelace (RTX 40), or Blackwell (RTX 50).\nNVIDIA driver-level Smooth Motion requires driver 571.86+ on Windows with RTX 40/50 natively, or RTX 30 via NVSmooth30.\nTuring (RTX 20 / GTX 16) and older architectures lack hardware support for driver-level frame generation.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 平滑动态原生支持 RTX 40 / 50，RTX 30 可用 NVSmooth30。RTX 20、GTX 16 及更早架构不支持。需要 Windows 版 571.86 或更高版本驱动。

NVIDIA Driver-Level Smooth Motion (requires driver 571.86+ on Windows):
Enables driver-level optical-flow frame interpolation directly via NVIDIA Driver Settings (DRS).
Strictly opt-in: intended for games that lack native DLSS Frame Generation support.
On GeForce RTX 30 (Ampere), this feature is unlocked via OptiScaler/nvsmooth30.dll.
Note: A game restart is required for NvPresent64 to attach to the DXGI swapchain.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 在 NVIDIA 驱动中启用光流插帧，适用于缺少原生 DLSS 帧生成的游戏。RTX 30 还需要 NVSmooth30。要求 Windows 版 571.86 或更高版本驱动，保存后重启游戏。

NVIDIA Driver-Level Smooth Motion (requires driver 571.86+ on Windows):
Enables driver-level optical-flow frame interpolation directly via NVIDIA Driver Settings (DRS).
Strictly opt-in: intended for games that lack native DLSS Frame Generation support.
Supported natively on GeForce RTX 40 (Ada) and RTX 50 (Blackwell) series GPUs.
Note: A game restart may be required for the driver to attach to the DXGI swapchain.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 在 NVIDIA 驱动中启用光流插帧，适用于缺少原生 DLSS 帧生成的游戏。RTX 40 / 50 原生支持。要求 Windows 版 571.86 或更高版本驱动，可能需要重启游戏。

NVSmooth30 Unlocker (placed in OptiScaler/nvsmooth30.dll):
Patches NvPresent64 architecture gates and redirects CUDA kernels to SM86,
allowing RTX 30 (Ampere) cards to run NVIDIA driver-level Smooth Motion.
Requires driver 571.86+ on Windows.
Note: A game restart is required for the unlocker to hook the DXGI presentation layer.
While NVSmooth30 is active, OptiScaler leaves Smooth Motion's swapchain unwrapped, so this
menu won't open from the next launch. Turn it back off in OptiScaler.ini ([DLSSG]
SmoothMotion or [SmoothMotion] EnableNVSmooth30).
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 供 RTX 30 使用的驱动级平滑动态，需要 Windows 版 571.86 或更高版本驱动。重启生效。启用后菜单可能无法打开，可在 OptiScaler.ini 的 SmoothMotion 或 EnableNVSmooth30 设置中关闭。

Off (default): while NVSmooth30 is loaded, OptiScaler gives the game a normal swapchain in
place of AMD's FSR Frame Generation swapchain (FSR FG can't run then). NVIDIA Smooth Motion
crashed on the FSR swapchain's presenter thread (e.g. Neverness to Everness, even with
FSR FG off).
On: leave the game's FSR FG swapchain alone.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 默认关闭，以避免平滑动态与 FSR 帧生成交换链发生冲突。打开后保留游戏自己的 FSR 帧生成交换链。

OptiScaler did not find NVIDIA's Smooth Motion (NvPresent64.dll) on the game's swapchain.
The detection is a heuristic and can miss it: check the frame rate with an external
overlay (PresentMon or the NVIDIA App). If it does not double, please report it with
OptiScaler.log and nvsmooth30.log (both next to the game's exe).
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 未检测到 NVIDIA 平滑动态。可用 PresentMon 或 NVIDIA App 查看实际帧率；如未翻倍，可将游戏目录中的 OptiScaler.log 和 nvsmooth30.log 随反馈提供。

Disabled: requires Streamline 2.11+ (sl.dlss_g.dll) and supporting driver runtime.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 需要 Streamline 2.11 或更高版本的 sl.dlss_g.dll，以及支持的驱动。

Display only XeFG generated frames (blanks native frames).\nUseful to visually verify if neural frame interpolation is working.
开启 DLSS 神经渲染。: 仅显示 XeFG 生成的帧，用于检查插帧是否真正生效。
